pages.title: Food Families
pages.text: Foods are grouped into $(thing)families$() based on what kind of food they are. Examples include $(thing)fish$(), $(thing)bread$(), and $(thing)leafy greens$().$(br2)Eating too many foods from the same family reduces nutrition returns across that entire family — even if the specific items are different.

pages.title: Food Families
pages.text: For example: eating salmon, then cod, then tuna in quick succession will build up $(thing)fish family fatigue$(). All three are different items, but they belong to the same family.$(br2)The Diet Screen shows your most fatigued families so you can see which kinds of food you have been over-relying on.
